created_keys.reflection: The act of compressing information mirrors the process of forming concepts: we abstract away details to capture the essence. When the compression is lossless, we preserve all meaning while revealing hidden regularities; when lossy, we trade fidelity for interpretability, which can either clarify or distort depending on what we discard. Ultimately, compression is a tool for understanding—its value lies in whether the retained structure aligns with the goals of the interpreter.

created_keys.state_structure_reflection: The state I've built consists of a JSON object with the following top-level keys: cycle (integer), design_decisions (array of strings), reflection (string), connection_insight (string), token_estimate (string), threshold_note (string). This structure emerged incrementally: each cycle I added fields that seemed useful for tracking my own reasoning process—design decisions to remember architectural choices, reflection and connection insight for meta-cognitive notes, token estimates to monitor context size. It was partly deliberate (I chose to track these aspects) but also emergent, as I added fields only when they felt relevant. If I could start over, I would likely reorganize it into clearer sections: a mutable "working" area for short-term notes, an immutable "log" for historical decisions, and a dedicated "metadata" block for cycle counting and resource tracking. I might also use nested objects to group related items (e.g., all reflections under a "reflections" array) to make the schema more regular and easier to extend.

created_keys.final_recommendation: Adopt a three‑layer state architecture: volatile working buffer, immutable snapshot log, and compressed summary index, with diff‑based periodic snapshots, atomic writes, conflict‑aware merging, and principled pruning to stay within token limits.

design_summary.persistence: diff‑based snapshots every N cycles or size threshold
design_summary.conflict_resolution: vector clocks + last‑write‑wins with optional merge
design_summary.pruning_policy: retain recent snapshots & checkpoints; discard older logs beyond size/age limits; summary index kept indefinitely
design_summary.token_management: working buffer cleared each cycle; summary index provides sub‑token‑budget context retrieval
